questions.q: What does the author test in this video?
questions.e: In the video: "U današnjem videu testiram špijunske alate koji će mi pomoći da čujem sve, vidim sve, da uđem bilo gde i na kraju da postanem bilo ko." — in today's video I test spy tools that will help me hear everything, see everything, get in anywhere and finally become anyone.

questions.q: What does the eavesdropping device look like?
o: Like an ordinary flash drive with a microphone
questions.e: In the video: "Spolja izgleda kao najobičnija fleška, ali unutra imate mikrofon i ulaz za SD karticu" — outside it looks like the most ordinary flash drive, but inside you have a microphone and an SD card slot.

questions.q: Why did the flash drive get 9 out of 10, not 10?
questions.e: In the video: "Jedino zašto je 9 od 10... jer piše ovde „voice recorder“" — the only reason it's 9 out of 10 is that it says "voice recorder" here.

questions.q: How do you find the location of a car with a GPS tracker?
o: Send an SMS to the number 999 and receive a link to maps
questions.e: In the video: "Pošaljete poruku 999 i odmah nakon toga vam stigne link ka Google mapama" — you send a message to 999 and right after that a link to Google Maps arrives.

questions.q: What did the carVertical app reveal about David's car?
o: The car was never in an accident
The mileage was rolled back and the car was damaged at the rear
questions.e: In the video: "Davide, ovde piše da je tvoj auto prešao 426.000 km. Meni na satu piše 250... vraćana ti je kilometraža" — David, it says here your car has gone 426,000 km. My dashboard says 250... your mileage was rolled back.

questions.q: How does the hidden camera detector work?
o: It reflects infrared light, and glints reveal the camera
questions.e: In the video: "reflektuje infracrvenu svetlost i vi kroz ovo sočivo možete naći gde je kamera sakrivena" — it reflects infrared light and through this lens you can find where the camera is hidden.

questions.q: How many ducklings did he manage to find with the night-vision glasses?
questions.e: In the video: "Uspeo sam da nađem samo dve patkice" — I managed to find only two ducklings.

questions.q: What happened with the hidden-camera glasses?
o: They recorded video in night mode
They recorded nothing — a score of zero
questions.e: In the video: "ocena za ove naočare je jedna velika, apsolutna nula, zato što naočare ništa nisu snimile" — the rating for these glasses is one big, absolute zero, because the glasses recorded nothing.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Moram naučiti da neprimetno *prisluškujem* razgovore.
questions.e: Prisluškivati — to eavesdrop.

questions.q: *Krišom* sam na njegov auto stavio ovaj lokator.
questions.e: Krišom — secretly, covertly.

questions.q: Da li je vraćana *kilometraža*?
questions.e: Kilometraža — a car's mileage.

questions.q: Mogu da *uhodim* nekoga, a da on to ne zna.
questions.e: Uhoditi — to track, to shadow.

questions.q: Bukvalno otvorite *katanac* bez ključa.
questions.e: Katanac — a padlock.

questions.q: Brave koje čuvaju vaš stan od *provalnika*.
questions.e: Provalnik — a burglar, a thief.

questions.q: Mogu li da se *prerušim* u dedu?
questions.e: Prerušiti se — to disguise oneself, to put on a disguise.

questions.q: Da li je dovoljno da *zavara* Davida?
questions.e: Zavarati — to mislead, to deceive.

questions.q: Imaju deset ___, deset pasoša i deset ličnosti.
questions.e: After the number 10 the genitive plural is used: imena.

questions.q: Krišom sam na njegov ___ stavio lokator.
questions.e: Na in answer to "where to?" — accusative case; for inanimate nouns it coincides with the nominative: auto.

questions.q: Pozvao sam Davida da nas vozi u ___.
questions.e: U in answer to "where to?" — accusative case: u prodavnicu.

questions.q: Sedi časkom tu, ja idem da ___ nešto tamo u kuhinji.
questions.e: After "idem da" a single purpose takes the perfective: snimim. Snimam is imperfective (ongoing).

questions.q: da pronađe ___ kameru u mrklom mraku.
questions.e: Kamera is feminine and the direct object takes the accusative, hence the ending -u: skrivenu kameru.

questions.q: a i još malo nam fali ___ 50.000.
questions.e: Faliti do + genitive means "to be short of": fali do 50.000.

questions.q: Šta je sa pravim ___?
questions.e: Sa + instrumental plural: sa pravim bravama — with real locks.

questions.q: Kada ključ uđe u ___, pomera pinove.
questions.e: Ući u + accusative case: u ključaonicu.
